tests: the content-dependent not-applicable arm names its own evaluated unmet precondition, so a legitimate no-op is distinguishable from a skipped gate

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/gates/citations.ts resolves a MADE citation by spawning `git cat-file -t <rev>:<path>`, so red-witness rule (f) binds this witness (SPAWN_GREP matches the changed file). Reaching the arm under test is a statement ABOUT that resolution: it is the state where every parsed citation in the changed documents was self-referential or external and none resolved to a local blob. The named test therefore reads the recorded contract (present path exit 0 / "blob"; absent path exit 128 / "does not exist", captured 2026-08-07 against git 2.43.0) and asserts a live scratch repo reproduces it before exercising the arm, so the behaviour is anchored to real git output rather than a hand-written string (CLAUDE.md warning 10).
